title: Data and code for: From Storms to Low Flows: Storage and Drainage in a Bedrock Hillslope Aquifer
description: Frozen manuscript inputs, three executed analysis notebooks, the interannual recession script, calibration and integration audit tables, derived tables, and figure outputs for groundwater storage and drainage at Rivendell, Elder Creek, California. Version 0.3.0 adds the interannual analysis: seasonal peak storage, storage after the final detected groundwater response, subsequent runoff, the pooled daily storage-runoff relation, the September 1 low-flow fit, and the precipitation elasticity of annual low flow. Earlier corrections to neutron-probe calibration, storage integration intervals, and groundwater gap handling are retained.
